purpose: Define machine validation of label identity, context, translation coverage, placeholder compatibility and machine-identifier separation across language packs.

topics.name: Localization Validation
topics.purpose: Define machine validation of label identity, context, translation coverage, placeholder compatibility and machine-identifier separation across language packs.

semantics.placeholder_rule: Runtime placeholders/tokens present in source text must remain semantically compatible in translations.
semantics.coverage_rule: Coverage is measured against the active label registry/snapshot.
semantics.language_rule: Each declared language pack validates independently.
semantics.severity_rule: Missing optional translation may be warning; missing required release translation follows deployment/release policy.
semantics.diff_rule: Changed source/context invalidates translation review state where policy requires.
semantics.report_rule: Validation reports missing/stale/invalid translations by exact label identity.

invariants.rule: Localization changes human-facing labels and explanatory text only; canonical identities, commands and machine semantics remain language-independent.

hard_gates.condition: translated command/internal identifier detected but accepted
coverage calculated from filesystem names instead of label registry
stale translation remains marked reviewed after incompatible source/context change
